title: Smoothness from a localization span in arbitrary universes
statement: For commutative rings R and A with an R-algebra structure, if a set s spans the unit ideal of A and every principal localization at an element of s is smooth over R, then A is smooth over R.

proof.text: Apply the finite principal-cover smoothness criterion, with the algebra structures transported so that R and A may lie in different universes.

lean.statement: theorem smooth_of_localization_span_universes (R : Type u) (A : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] (s : Set A) (hs : Ideal.span s = ⊤) (h : ∀ g : s, Smooth R (Localization.Away (g : A))) : Smooth R A
